messages:
alex: Quick status check on Dedicated buildout for Q2 ramp. Need short updates: procurement ETA, rack power cert, network L2 config, and reservation slot confirmation. Owning teams: @maya (infra), @raj (platform), @sara (procurement), @dan (network).

maya: infra: racks staged at DC3, power PDUs shipped, waiting on PDUs firmware image to be validated by infra-sre. ETA for smoke = Tue EOD. :thumbsup:

raj: platform: cluster manifests mostly ready. Need final mapping of SKUs to reservation IDs (from procurement). Also I filed PR #842 for autoscaler tweaks — @maya can you take a look? Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/842

sara: procurement: ETA for H100 wave 2 is Apr 18 (tracking from vendor). We've got 40/80 units confirmed. Need to confirm customs hold on the remaining 40 — pinged vendor, awaiting reply by EOD today.

dan: network: L2 configs reviewed, but we need final cable map from on-site techs. Also awaiting rack U numbering confirmation. Will schedule a 30m walk-through Wed 10am. Can @maya share the rack list?

maya: sending rack list now. paste: ```DC3-RACK-01..10
units: U1-U42
power: dual-PDU
reserved-for: redwood-dedicated``` Also tagging @ops-bot to schedule smoke window.

ops-bot: sched request created: smoke-window DC3 Apr 19 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pinged oncall. Link: https://ops.redwood/schedule/req/1993

alex: Questions: 1) reservation IDs — sara can you confirm mapping by EOD? 2) PR review — @maya can you triage tomorrow morning? 3) fallback plan if customs delays: @raj can we spin up temporary capacity in region-east? (short-term) 

sara: reservation mapping — yes, working it. Will post csv by 18:00 UTC. If customs blocks more than 48h we'll prioritize region-east hot spare and reassign tickets.

raj: region-east can handle ~30% of expected load in short term. Need a code flip for routing policy — I can do a canary rollout but need a signed off rollback window. Proposed plan: 1h canary at 5% traffic, then 30m ramp. Anyone object?

maya: LGTM for canary plan. Need to ensure cache warmers are preloaded — I'll add a job to the runbook.

dan: walk-through ok for Wed 10am, will bring floor plan. If PDUs firmware fails, fallback is manual BMC reset per runbook-ops-v2.

alex: action items summary: - @sara post reservation CSV by 18:00 UTC - @maya review PR #842 by 10:00 UTC tomorrow - @dan confirm walk-through attendee list - @raj prep canary rollout doc and rollback timeline. I'll follow up in morning. :white_check_mark:

maya: noted. I'll post PR review comments and add cache warmer job link.

sara: posted CSV: https://files.redwood/reservations/dc3-wave2.csv — check mapping. Marking done here. :pray:

raj: uploaded canary doc: https://confluence.redwood/ops/dedicated-canary-v2 — comments welcome. I'll tag SRE.

alex: thanks team. If nobody else, closing the async loop. Will bump in #eng-platform tomorrow if anything slips.
